## Orientation

Parallel tasks in this wave edit disjoint files. Stay inside your task scope. Install node_modules in your worktree with `npm ci` in `dashboard/web/ui` when you need npm. Do not push.

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/node-ci--fix-gate-test-isolation`

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R1: The CI job `web` runs `npm ci`, `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` in `dashboard/web/ui`, in that order. The integration test that runs these lines must not change the real `node_modules`.

## Approach

In `tests/test_web_gate.py`, run every `web` job line, including `npm ci`, in a temporary copy of the UI that has its own `node_modules`. Do not symlink the real `node_modules` for that test. The test keeps asserting that the job exists and that every line exits 0. Oracle-author amends the test; the parent re-freezes the hashes.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R1: The CI job `web` runs `npm ci`, `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` in `dashboard/web/ui`, in that order.

### Design / decisions (quote)

- The lint gate allows zero findings.
- The `web` job has no path filter and no dependency on other jobs.

- A Node version exists that Vite 8 and the pinned Biome both support.
- The Biome rule set can be tuned (for example `noNonNullAssertion`) in `biome.json` without per-line suppressions.

- `web-ci-job-shape`: One web job that always runs
